scams.name: Ijen Crater Mandatory Guide Shakedown at Paltuding Base
scams.description: Kawah Ijen (2,799m) — the iconic blue-flame volcanic crater with the world's largest acidic turquoise lake — requires a 3-km hike from Paltuding base to the crater rim. Since 2023 the East Java provincial government has officially required a licensed guide for the BLUE FLAME descent (into the crater from the rim to the sulfur-mining level). Traveler reports document both the regulation and the practical 2024–2025 experience. The 2025 scams at Paltuding: (a) unlicensed 'guides' at the trailhead demanding Rp 300K–500K per person for the crater-rim walk (which does NOT require a guide); the legitimate guide requirement applies ONLY to the blue-flame descent into the crater; (b) legitimate licensed guides charge Rp 200K–350K per group (not per person) for the blue-flame descent; (c) 'entry fee + guide combo Rp 800K' — the real park entry is Rp 150K weekday / Rp 250K weekend per foreigner, guide separate; (d) 'mandatory gas mask Rp 100K rental' — real rate is Rp 30K–50K for a 3M-canister mask; (e) 'compulsory emergency fee Rp 100K' — no such fee exists. Traveler reports also document the tour-package alternative for those wanting a simpler option. For older travelers — the 3-km 1-hour-each-way crater-rim hike is achievable for moderately fit 60+ travelers; the blue-flame DESCENT (another 700m down into the crater on loose acidic terrain with toxic gas) is NOT recommended above 65 or with ANY heart/lung condition: (1) the crater-rim walk requires NO guide and NO fee beyond park entry; (2) park entry is Rp 150K weekday / Rp 250K weekend per foreigner; (3) if descending to blue flames, a LICENSED guide IS required (check badge, request registration number) — Rp 200K–350K PER GROUP not per person; (4) rent gas mask at Paltuding at Rp 30K–50K — essential for blue-flame descent, recommended for rim; (5) REFUSE all 'mandatory emergency fee' and 'per-person guide' demands at the trailhead; (6) for rim-only visit, arrive at Paltuding 12 AM–1 AM to reach rim for 3–4 AM sunrise; (7) wear sturdy hiking shoes, layers (0–10°C at rim), headlamp with spare batteries; (8) check your travel insurance — Ijen is high-altitude + toxic gas + active volcano, many default policies exclude.
scams.avoidance: Park entry: Rp 150K weekday / Rp 250K weekend per foreigner — that's it Crater-rim walk: NO guide required; descent: yes, Rp 200K–350K PER GROUP Verify licensed guide badge + registration number before paying Rent gas mask at Paltuding at Rp 30K–50K (3M canister type) REFUSE ALL 'emergency fee' and 'per-person guide' demands
scams.location: Paltuding base camp (Ijen main trailhead), Banyuwangi/Bondowoso approach roads, Kawah Ijen crater rim, blue-flame descent to acid lake

scams.name: Ijen Gas Mask Rental Overcharge & Fake-Model Fraud
scams.description: Kawah Ijen's crater contains the world's most acidic lake and emits hydrogen sulfide + sulfur dioxide gas — a proper gas mask (3M 6001 canister or equivalent with acid-gas filter) is ESSENTIAL for any descent and strongly recommended for even the crater rim on windward days. Tourists often don't know what 'proper' looks like, creating a 2025 fake-mask and overcharge ecosystem. Traveler reports document mask preparation requirements and 2025 trip-report experiences. The 2025 scams: (a) Paltuding rentals charging Rp 100K–150K for a 'gas mask' that's actually a N95 surgical mask with a plastic cover — USELESS against H2S; (b) tour packages 'gas mask included' that provide cheap dust masks; (c) 'premium gas mask Rp 300K' claimed to be military-grade — real 3M 6001 + 6000-series full-face rental is Rp 50K–100K; (d) Banyuwangi hotel-lobby rentals at Rp 200K for low-quality masks; (e) 'acid-filter cartridge Rp 150K' surcharge — legitimate rentals include proper cartridges in base fee. For older travelers AND anyone descending to blue flames: (1) CONFIRM the mask is 3M 6000-series (6200, 6800, 7502) half-face or full-face with P100 + acid-gas cartridges — photograph the mask brand/model before accepting rental; reject if anything different; (2) real rental rate at Paltuding is Rp 30K–50K for half-face, Rp 75K–100K for full-face 3M; (3) N95 surgical masks are USELESS against H2S — walk away from any vendor offering one; (4) for serious visitors, buy a proper 3M mask at home before travel (US$20–$35 on Amazon) — more comfortable, guaranteed fit, own hygiene; (5) adjust straps BEFORE entering gas zone — a loose mask is no protection; (6) if wearing glasses, half-face masks work poorly — consider full-face or prescription insert; (7) do NOT descend if you have asthma, COPD, or heart failure even with a mask — gas exposure can be severe; (8) wind direction matters — on leeward days, even rim exposure is unpleasant.
scams.avoidance: Verify 3M 6000-series mask + P100/acid-gas cartridges BEFORE accepting Photograph brand/model before taking; reject anything else Paltuding real rate: Rp 30K–50K half-face, Rp 75K–100K full-face 3M For serious visitors, buy own 3M mask at home (US$20–$35, better fit) Do NOT descend if asthma/COPD/heart failure — even with mask
scams.location: Paltuding base camp gas-mask rental huts, tour-guide bundled rentals, Banyuwangi hotel lobby rentals, tour-van gas-mask sales

scams.name: Banyuwangi Airport (BWX) & Ferry Terminal Taxi Overcharge
scams.description: Banyuwangi is East Java's easternmost city and the launching point for the Kawah Ijen sunrise tour — accessible via Banyuwangi Airport (BWX, small but growing) or via Ketapang ferry from Bali's Gilimanuk port (cheapest Bali-Java connection). The small-city tourism ecosystem creates 2025 taxi-overcharge patterns. The legitimate rates: BWX airport to central Banyuwangi (12 km) is Rp 75K–125K via Grab; Ketapang ferry terminal to central Banyuwangi (5 km) is Rp 40K–75K via Grab; central Banyuwangi to Paltuding base camp (40 km, 1.5 hour mountain drive) is Rp 250K–400K via Grab OR Rp 350K–500K via chartered 4x4 (needed for the steep last 10 km). The 2025 scams: (a) BWX arrivals-kerb taxi kiosks quoting Rp 250K–400K for the 12-km transfer (real Rp 75K–125K); (b) 'direct to Paltuding for Ijen Rp 1.5M' quoted by arrivals touts (real rate Rp 350K–500K); (c) Ketapang ferry touts on the Gilimanuk-Java side offering 'immediate Banyuwangi taxi' at Rp 300K (real Rp 40K–75K); (d) Grab 'doesn't work here' misdirection — Grab IS available throughout Banyuwangi but with 10–15 min wait; (e) unlicensed 4x4 at Paltuding approach with inflated 'mountain premium' at Rp 800K one-way. For older travelers: (1) most Banyuwangi hotels catering to Ijen tourists include free airport transfer with advance booking — USE THIS; (2) if paying, book via hotel or Grab — typical fare BWX-central Rp 75K–125K; Ketapang-central Rp 40K–75K; (3) for central-Banyuwangi-to-Paltuding, arrange via your hotel or Klook at Rp 350K–500K with licensed 4x4 driver (the last 10 km IS steep and needs 4x4); (4) for post-Ijen hike, arrange driver-wait during your trek; (5) IGNORE every airport-kerb kiosk quote above Rp 200K; (6) Grab IS available in Banyuwangi (confirmed 2025) — allow 10–15 min wait; (7) if you're combining Ijen with Bali via Ketapang ferry, the ferry is Rp 10K per foot passenger (5–10 min actual crossing) — no mafia here, just follow the pedestrian lane; (8) most Ijen tours from Bali include the Ketapang ferry and Banyuwangi transfer in package.
scams.avoidance: Use hotel free-transfer on advance booking (most Ijen hotels include) BWX-central via Grab Rp 75K–125K; Ketapang-central Rp 40K–75K For Paltuding transfer, book hotel/Klook at Rp 350K–500K with licensed 4x4 IGNORE every arrivals-kerb quote above Rp 200K Grab IS available throughout Banyuwangi — wait 10–15 min
scams.location: Banyuwangi Airport (BWX) arrivals, Ketapang ferry terminal (Bali-Java crossing), Banyuwangi city center, Ijen tour departure points

scams.name: Ijen Blue Flame Timing Scam & Late-Arrival 'Just Missed It' Fraud
scams.description: The Kawah Ijen blue flames (ignited sulfuric gas at the crater's sulfur-mining level, visible only in pre-dawn darkness) are the reason most tourists visit. Visibility requires: (1) being at the sulfur-mining level BEFORE 4 AM; (2) clear weather; (3) gas masks and guide. The tight timing window creates a 2025 'just missed it' fraud pattern. Traveler reports document the blue-flame timing logistics. The 2025 scams: (a) tour operators scheduling departure from Banyuwangi at 12 AM (should be 11 PM latest) — deliberately arriving at crater rim after 4 AM (blue flames gone) but charging full 'blue flame tour' price; (b) 'guide' at crater rim claiming 'too late for blue flame' at 3:30 AM and offering 'special descent Rp 500K extra' to recover the experience (real answer: keep walking down, blue flames still visible); (c) group tours that deliberately slow-pace the hike with 'rest stops' to arrive late; (d) 'blue flame guarantee Rp 200K' sold at departure — weather/timing dependent, nothing can guarantee; (e) late refund-refusal — if tourist misses blue flames due to operator lateness, no refund offered. For older travelers AND anyone prioritising blue flames: (1) for blue flames, you MUST be at the sulfur-mining level (crater floor, 700m below rim) BEFORE 4 AM — plan departure from Banyuwangi/Banyuwangi hotel at 10:30 PM–11 PM; (2) reputable operators depart by 11 PM: Sun Tours Ijen, Kawah Ijen Private Tour, Banyuwangi Ijen Adventure; (3) reach Paltuding by 12 AM, start hike 12:15 AM, reach rim by 2:15 AM, descent to blue-flame zone by 3 AM; (4) if your operator is departing after 11 PM, CANCEL and rebook with compliant operator — late departure = no blue flames by physics; (5) REFUSE 'blue flame guarantee' — no operator can guarantee weather; (6) if you miss blue flames, the crater rim at sunrise (5:15 AM) is STILL spectacular (the turquoise acid lake is the daytime highlight); (7) for older travelers who can't descend, rim-only sunrise view is the recommended goal — no blue flames but stunning; (8) allow 3+ hours at Paltuding for the full experience.
scams.avoidance: Depart Banyuwangi by 10:30–11 PM — physics of timing is strict Book Sun Tours Ijen, Kawah Ijen Private Tour, Banyuwangi Ijen Adventure If operator schedules 12 AM departure, CANCEL and rebook compliant REFUSE 'blue flame guarantee' — no operator can guarantee weather If flames missed, sunrise crater rim (5:15 AM) is still spectacular
scams.location: Paltuding base camp departure, crater rim arrival, blue-flame descent to sulfur-mining level, sunrise crater viewpoint

scams.name: Banyuwangi ATM Skimming & Remote Cash-Exchange Fraud
scams.description: Banyuwangi's rapid Ijen-driven tourism growth has created a 2025 ATM-skimming and cash-exchange-fraud ecosystem that mirrors Bali's pattern in a thinner-monitored environment. Traveler reports from Bali document the canonical 2025 skimmer patterns; cloned cards from Banyuwangi ATMs are typically used within 1–2 hours at Bali merchants. Community logistics threads also cover Banyuwangi cash-management. The 2025 patterns: (a) freestanding city-center ATMs (not bank-branch) with card-reader overlays + pinhole cameras; (b) hotel-lobby ATMs at tourist Ijen-package hotels from independent operators (not bank-branded) — high-risk; (c) Ketapang ferry terminal cash kiosks with tampered calculators displaying inflated conversion rates; (d) 'no ATM working in town, exchange with me' cover story followed by 8–10% rate padding; (e) rural approach-road ATMs on the Banyuwangi-Paltuding drive — isolated and skimmer-compromised; (f) credit-card surcharge fraud at tour operators: 5–8% 'processing fee' not disclosed at booking. For older travelers: (1) withdraw Rp 2M–4M cash in BALI or at a major Jakarta/Surabaya bank-branch ATM BEFORE travelling to Banyuwangi — this avoids the thinner local ATM risk; (2) if withdrawing in Banyuwangi, use ONLY ATMs INSIDE bank branches (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI) on Jl. Jaksa Agung Suprapto or Jl. MT Haryono during business hours (8 AM–4 PM Mon–Fri); (3) cover keypad when entering PIN; wiggle card slot before inserting; (4) AVOID every freestanding, hotel-lobby, or ferry-terminal ATM; (5) set low daily withdrawal limits (Rp 1.5M–2M) and real-time transaction alerts on your bank app; (6) for cash exchange, use reputable money changer PT Central Kuta or BMC (Bali locations) BEFORE travelling — avoid Banyuwangi hotel-lobby rate padding; (7) CONFIRM credit-card surcharge policy at tour booking in writing — should be 0–3% max; (8) if skimmed, contact your bank IMMEDIATELY via hotel Wi-Fi; file a report at Polres Banyuwangi (+62 333 424 143) for chargeback documentation; (9) keep one dedicated travel debit card separate from main account.
scams.avoidance: Withdraw 3–5 day cash buffer in BALI/Surabaya BEFORE Banyuwangi In Banyuwangi, use ONLY bank-branch ATMs during business hours Cover keypad; wiggle card slot; avoid freestanding/hotel/ferry ATMs Set low daily limits and transaction alerts on bank app Confirm credit-card surcharge (0–3% max) at tour booking in writing
scams.location: Banyuwangi city-center ATMs, hotel-lobby ATMs at Ijen tour hotels, Ketapang ferry terminal cash kiosks, rural approach-road ATMs

scams.name: Ijen Sulfur-Miner Photo Forced-Tip & Commission Selfie Scam
scams.description: Kawah Ijen is one of the world's last active manual sulfur mines — miners carry 70–90 kg sulfur chunks up the steep crater walls by hand twice daily. The dramatic backdrop makes for iconic photographs, and miners SOMETIMES welcome small tips for poses. But a 2025 commission-selfie scam has emerged. Traveler reports and 2025 trip reports document the pattern. The 2025 scams: (a) 'miner' who's actually an English-speaking tourist-wrangler (not a real miner) posing aggressively and demanding Rp 100K–200K per photo — real miners don't speak English and don't ask; (b) 'photo with real sulfur pole Rp 150K' upsell where the pole is a prop; (c) unofficial 'sulfur souvenir Rp 100K' (small chunk for tourist pocket) — most tour operators don't allow this and proper export is illegal; (d) 'miner donation fundraiser Rp 200K for his family' — well-intentioned tourists over-tip a fake fundraiser; legitimate mining co-op donations go to Ijen Miners Welfare via Banyuwangi hotel front desks; (e) forced-tip for 'carrying your bag' where a 'helpful miner' grabs your backpack then demands Rp 100K at descent. For older travelers: (1) fair-compensation tip for a genuine miner photo is Rp 20K–50K (or a cigarette, traditional small gift) — the mining work is genuinely dangerous + low-paid; (2) REFUSE English-speaking 'miners' demanding Rp 100K+ per photo — real miners are too busy carrying loads and don't speak English; (3) no pole or prop requires a 'fee' — photograph from a respectful distance without commissioning poses; (4) sulfur souvenirs are NOT legal to export (customs will confiscate) and fragment your luggage with sulfurous residue; (5) for genuine support, donate to Ijen Miners Welfare Fund via your Banyuwangi hotel — hotel will take cash donation with receipt, funds tracked; (6) if someone grabs your backpack, firmly say 'saya tidak butuh bantuan' (I don't need help) and take it back — don't engage; (7) photograph miners from a respectful distance — they are working, not posing; (8) the real story: each miner carries 70–90 kg twice daily for ~Rp 100K–150K earnings — your Rp 20K–50K tip is meaningful contribution.
scams.avoidance: Fair miner-photo tip: Rp 20K–50K (or small gift); real miners don't ask REFUSE English-speaking 'miners' quoting Rp 100K+ per photo Don't buy sulfur souvenirs — illegal export + luggage contamination For genuine support, donate to Ijen Miners Welfare via hotel (with receipt) Photograph miners from respectful distance — they are working
scams.location: Ijen crater rim sulfur-mining observation points, blue-flame descent paths, sulfur-processing station at crater exit, Paltuding descent trail
